text: Lusíadas is the brand of Grupo Lusíadas Saúde, which joined the French group Vivalto Santé at the end of 2022. Vivalto Partners, the management company set up in 2021 by Vivalto Santé's founder and CEO Daniel Caille, is Vivalto Santé's controlling shareholder, alongside the institutional investors IK Partners, MACSF, Bpifrance, Mubadala, Arkéa Capital, Groupe Crédit Agricole and BNPP.
short: Lusíadas belongs to Grupo Lusíadas Saúde, part of France's Vivalto Santé since 2022.
